subject: general
question: What were the two major cities under the control of the Chahamanas?
solution:
__
 
• **Delhi and Ajmer**__ were the two major cities under control of the Chahamanas.
 
• The Chahamanas were an Indian dynasty.
 
• They ruled parts of Rajasthan and its neighbouring places between 7th to 12th centuries. 
 
• They had their capital at Shakambhari, which is now known as Sambhar.
